blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cale88, a company in which lawyer Manases Carpio, Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, has a 47.5 percent stake, had reported audited sales of P208 million from 2022 to 2025 but had P776 million in corporate inflows, as reflected in Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) records. “What’s the possible reason for the big discrepancy?” Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian asked Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo, who testified on Friday on the 45th day of the vice president’s impeachment trial, as managing head of the Bureau of Investments (BOI).
